courses.name: Advanced Paediatric Life Support (APLS)
courses.audience: Doctors, nurses and paramedics with a minimum of two years clinical experience; junior clinicians are pointed to the one-day PLS course.

audienceEvidence.quote: The APLS course is designed for doctors, nurses and paramedics with a minimum of two years’ clinical experience.

courses.format: Mandatory pre-course online learning, then three face-to-face days (scenarios, skill stations, workshops) with practical and written assessment.

formatEvidence.quote: Three days face-to-face, 10 hours+ pre-course preparation

courses.validityQuote: candidates are issued with a certificate valid for five years.
courses.recertification: APLS 2 Day Refresher (variant "refresher"): for people who completed a full APLS course within the last 5 years and are clinically current with paediatric patients; accreditation again lasts 5 years.

recertificationEvidence.quote: To be eligible to attend a 2 Day Refresher, we request that you have (a) successfully completed a full APLS course within the last 5 years ... Accreditation lasts for 5 years, same as the 3 day course.

courses.feeNote: Each 2027 event in the Arlo feed advertises $3,300 and a discounted offer of $2,120 (refresher $2,800 / $2,120); the course text still says $1,920. Check before showing a nurse price.
courses.cpdNote: check provider (Arlo template lists Credits "PD points: 3" with no college or unit named)
courses.notInScopeYet: PLS (one-day Paediatric Life Support) is also in the APLS feed (template 37) and was not added.

courses.name: Advanced Life Support Level 1 (ALS1)

providers.name: Australian Resuscitation Council (ARC); delivered by ARC-accredited course centres
The Prince Charles Hospital, Metro North (course centre)

courses.audience: Healthcare staff with limited or infrequent exposure to crisis events who need ALS training; CPR competence is a prerequisite.

audienceEvidence.quote: It is ideal for those in healthcare with limited or infrequent exposure to crisis events needing advanced life support training.

courses.format: Course manual sent at least two weeks before, then a one-day face-to-face course.

formatEvidence.quote: This is a one-day course ... Candidates are sent a manual at least two weeks prior to the course to commence preparation for the face-to-face component.

courses.validityQuote: ALS1 and ALS2 Provider certificates are recognised by the Australian Resuscitation Council for four years . (Revalidation periods may vary based on the requirements of credentialling bodies or employers.)

recertificationEvidence.quote: To recertify ALS1 you will need to undertake another ALS1 course.

courses.feeNote: Fees are set by each course centre.

feeEvidence.quote: Course fees are set by the course centres and can vary across locations

courses.name: Advanced Life Support Level 2 (ALS2)

providers.name: Australian Resuscitation Council (ARC); delivered by ARC-accredited course centres
ACRRM: one-day ALS2 for rural doctors (variant "acrrm-one-day")

courses.audience: Doctors, critical-care nurses (ED, CCU, ICU, HDU, acute admissions), resuscitation/MET team members and paramedics; CPR competence is a prerequisite.

courses.audience: Rural generalists and other clinicians managing emergencies in pre-hospital, small rural hospital and rural practice settings.

audienceEvidence.quote: REST covers many of the common emergencies that are likely to present in the pre-hospital, small rural hospital, and private rural practice environments.

formatEvidence.quote: The REST course has approximately 12 hours of self-directed online learning followed by two hands-on workshop days.
